findings.result: UTF-8 patch checks and applies to the bound app tree; all 29 files match source bytes.
Version-1 Preferences parse without paused and default it to false.
A denied localStorage getter retains validated document-memory preferences across store/runtime instances.
Saved paused=true is active on initial real render after failed-load retry and after full /about navigation/re-entry.
Explicit painting spring settles while global pause remains set; greeting and rendered coding action are separately verified.
Required bytes remain indeterminate until three trustworthy same-representation lengths are known; shorter/longer EOF mismatches, compressed/unknown lengths, and ArrayBuffer byte length are covered.
Real indeterminate progress omits aria-valuenow and percent text and selects indeterminate styling.
Only required high-water/decode/integration progress resets the 15-second watchdog; a held production request fails at 15.34 seconds with retry and continue actions.
Generations are monotonic and stale token/generation progress and entrance callbacks cannot affect the current session.
Retry ceiling is two automatic retries with exact 500ms/1500ms waits, session-local policy, and abortable cleanup.
Throwing/rejected optional consumers release once; successful adoption uses the shared session ledger and optional abort remains independent.

Typed per-ID results buffer before integration and replay only to each ID?s target. Scene target resolution rejects absent IDs and installation is transactional; production browser reports desk_mat and monitor_screen_center separately.
Shared/pruned GLTF geometry, material, map texture, ImageBitmap, object URLs, and late registration are captured and released idempotently.
Late maps stay target-isolated across LOW/HIGH, use sRGB, roll back atomically, and are excluded from static batching by matching mutable-name rules.

Three production-Chromium scenarios cover loading, <50ms Continue, failed retry/recreation, pause restoration, rendered action time, route round-trip, late textures/quality, and genuine watchdog recovery.
Base identity, historical pause preference compatibility and denial-safe persistence.
Factual progress, generations, retry ceilings, watchdog and accessible recovery.
Typed, per-session optional result adoption and rollback.
Unified idempotent Three.js/bitmap/object-URL resource ownership.
Late material map refresh, LOW/HIGH consistency, exact target names and static batch exclusion.

limitations: This is implementation evidence from the assigned local worker, not GPT #2 independent audit or Parent acceptance.
The canonical app tree remains unchanged; integration requires a later explicit I1 packet after upstream platform/art corrections and this runtime revision are independently accepted.
Physical mobile devices, assistive-technology sessions, live hosted/CDN behavior and real context-loss recovery are not exercised by this local candidate.
The first parallel integration run exhausted Node worker memory. The successful serial worker run is recorded; the earlier OOM receipt is preserved.
